name: The Eastern Kingdoms
label: Quest
description: The Eastern Kingdoms: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: As Warchief, it is my duty to do what is best for the Horde. To ensure that the generations that come after us are not forced into a hopeless existence.

The opportunity to shape our future alliances has fallen into our collective laps. A move to help the dwarves could greatly strengthen our relationships in the Eastern Kingdoms. This, then, is why you must not fail!

clips.title: Completion
paras: There is no going back beyond this point, friend.
